flow: directional aggregate flow over the preceding event interval; snapshots do not reconstruct intrainterval exchange matching
fill_order: existing quotes evaluated from interval flow and the ending quote snapshot, then account marked, then strategy decision
nonadverse: opposite directional flow > 0 and independent uniform draw < configured p; existing quote can fill at its own price even when off current touch
adverse: ending bid below resting buy price or ending ask above resting sell price
limits: no price priority or queue/depth reconstruction
not a native exchange L1 execution model
no partial fills or endogenous maker impact
validation: independent adversarial off-touch buy/sell tests, probability boundaries, cancellations and ledger checks
scope: explicit unchanged bounded approximation; no claim that aggregate snapshots prove exchange-priority fills
